text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик has arrived at the Arima
Kinen
determined to make me the best
trainer in the
world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All at once, the entire crowd erupts into
cheers
for the both of us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The stage is set for Супер Крик to put
everything
we've trained for on the line.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
